id: 20_Maximum Power Transfer Theorem Viva Voce Questions and Answers Basic Electrical
title: 最大功率传输：口试问答与电池光伏安全

author_source: project/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/20_Maximum Power Transfer Theorem Viva Voce Questions and Answers Basic Electrical/src.py

points.K3: 最大功率时效率只有一半
points.K6: 应用：光伏最大功率点跟踪
points.K7: 应用：音频放大与收音机
points.S1: 电池没有开关，两极别短接
points.S2: 电池鼓包漏液停用，废电池回收

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台前，台上有电池组、滑线变阻器和电表
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lab bench with a battery pack, a sliding rheostat and a blank-dial meter, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 大家好！今天复习最大功率传输定理。
overlay: 最大功率传输：口试问答与电池光伏安全

shots.scene: 电池、变阻器、光伏板三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a battery, a sliding rheostat and a solar panel. No people.
shots.narration: 顺便聊聊电池和光伏板的安全。

shots.scene: 阿杰调变阻器，盯着功率表读数忽大忽小
shots.prompt_en: The young male student turns a sliding rheostat while watching a meter needle rise and fall.
shots.narration: 阿杰调负载，功率先升后降，纳闷了。

shots.scene: 小研在空白纸上画出一条先升后降的曲线
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sketches a curve that rises to a peak and then falls on a blank sheet.
shots.narration: 小研说：顶点那儿，就有门道。

shots.scene: 电源和内阻串联，外接一个可变负载电阻的电路图标
shots.prompt_en: A circuit icon: a source with an internal resistor in series, connected to a variable load resistor. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：什么是最大功率传输定理？

shots.scene: 天平两边分别放内阻和负载电阻，正好平衡
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with an internal resistor icon on one side and a load resistor icon on the other, perfectly level. No people.
shots.narration: 条件：负载电阻等于电源内阻。

shots.scene: 负载电阻图标亮起，功率柱达到最高
shots.prompt_en: The load resistor icon glows and a power bar reaches its highest point. No people.
shots.narration: 这时负载得到的功率最大。

shots.scene: 功率随负载变化的曲线，顶点被圈出
shots.prompt_en: A curve of power versus load resistance with its peak circled. No people.
shots.narration: 负载太大太小，功率都上不去。

shots.scene: 正弦波图标和一本空白高年级教材
shots.prompt_en: A sine wave icon next to a blank advanced textbook. No people.
shots.narration: 交流电路的条件，高年级再详细学。

shots.section_title: 最大功率时效率只有一半
shots.scene: 一个圆饼图一半给负载、一半在内阻上发热
shots.prompt_en: A pie chart split in half: one half flowing to the load, the other half turning into heat in the internal resistor. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：此时效率多少？百分之五十。
overlay: 最大功率时效率只有一半

shots.section_title: 最大功率时效率只有一半
shots.scene: 内阻图标冒出热气
shots.prompt_en: An internal resistor icon giving off heat waves. No people.
shots.narration: 一半功率，消耗在电源内部。

shots.scene: 白板上写着最大功率公式
shots.prompt_en: A whiteboard with a maximum power formula in symbols only. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：最大功率有多大？

shots.scene: 公式中分母的 4 和负载电阻被高亮
shots.prompt_en: The denominator of the formula highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 电动势平方，除以四倍负载电阻。

shots.scene: 一节电池剖开，里面有一个小电阻图标
shots.prompt_en: A battery icon cut open, revealing a small resistor icon inside. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：什么是内阻？

shots.scene: 电池符号与一个电阻串联，被圈在一起
shots.prompt_en: A battery symbol in series with a small resistor, both circled together. No people.
shots.narration: 电源内部本身就有电阻，画成串联。

shots.scene: 欧姆符号图标
shots.prompt_en: A large ohm symbol icon. No people.
shots.narration: 内阻的单位也是欧姆。

shots.section_title: 应用：光伏最大功率点跟踪
shots.scene: 屋顶上的光伏板，太阳时隐时现
shots.prompt_en: A solar panel on a rooftop under a sun that moves in and out of clouds. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：应用。光伏发电最典型。
overlay: 应用：光伏最大功率点跟踪

shots.section_title: 应用：光伏最大功率点跟踪
shots.scene: 光照强弱变化，光伏板输出柱子跟着高低起伏
shots.prompt_en: As sunlight brightens and dims, a power bar beside the solar panel rises and falls. No people.
shots.narration: 光照一变，光伏板的输出就变。

shots.section_title: 应用：光伏最大功率点跟踪
shots.scene: 一个控制盒连着光伏板，曲线顶点上有一个小圆点跟着移动
shots.prompt_en: A small controller box connected to a solar panel, and a dot that keeps tracking the peak of a power curve. No people.
shots.narration: 跟踪控制器随时找功率最高点。

shots.section_title: 应用：光伏最大功率点跟踪
shots.scene: 小研指着跟踪曲线讲解
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at the tracking curve on a board and explains.
shots.narration: 让光伏板始终输出最大功率。

shots.section_title: 应用：音频放大与收音机
shots.scene: 功放和音箱图标
shots.prompt_en: An audio amplifier icon connected to a loudspeaker icon. No people.
shots.narration: 功放带音箱，也讲究匹配。
overlay: 应用：音频放大与收音机

shots.section_title: 应用：音频放大与收音机
shots.scene: 老式收音机调谐旋钮图标
shots.prompt_en: An old radio icon with a tuning knob. No people.
shots.narration: 收音机调谐，也用到这个思想。

shots.scene: 阿杰举手，王老师走过来
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand and the safety administrator walks over.
shots.narration: 复习有疑问，及时问老师。

shots.section_title: 电池没有开关，两极别短接
shots.scene: 电池组图标，两极闪着小闪电，没有开关
shots.prompt_en: A battery pack icon with small lightning symbols at both terminals and no switch. No people.
shots.narration: 电池没有开关，随时都带电。
overlay: 电池没有开关，两极别短接

shots.section_title: 电池没有开关，两极别短接
shots.scene: 扳手横搭在电池两极上冒火花的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a metal wrench lying across both battery terminals with sparks, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 金属工具搭住两极，会短路发烫。

shots.section_title: 电池没有开关，两极别短接
shots.scene: 小研给电池端子套上绝缘护帽
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fits insulating caps onto the terminals of a battery pack.
shots.narration: 不用时套上护帽，正负分开放。

shots.section_title: 电池鼓包漏液停用，废电池回收
shots.scene: 鼓包、漏液的电池图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a swollen battery and a leaking battery. No people.
shots.narration: 电池鼓包、漏液、发烫，都是危险信号。
overlay: 电池鼓包漏液停用，废电池回收

shots.section_title: 电池鼓包漏液停用，废电池回收
shots.scene: 阿杰把鼓包电池放进防火盒，向王老师报告
shots.prompt_en: The young male student places a swollen battery into a fireproof box and reports to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 立即停用，隔离存放，报告老师。

shots.section_title: 电池鼓包漏液停用，废电池回收
shots.scene: 废电池被投进专用回收箱
shots.prompt_en: Used batteries being dropped into a dedicated battery recycling bin. No people.
shots.narration: 废电池投进专用回收箱，不混扔。

shots.scene: 阳光照在光伏板上，接线端闪着闪电符号
shots.prompt_en: Sunlight falls on a solar panel and lightning symbols glow at its output terminals. No people.
shots.narration: 光伏板见了光，就会发电。

shots.scene: 以为没接电源就去摸光伏板接线的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand touching solar panel output leads in sunlight, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 没接电源，端子照样有电压。

shots.scene: 老李用不透光的布盖住光伏板后再接线
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer covers a solar panel with an opaque cloth before working on its wiring.
shots.narration: 接线前遮光，并按老师要求操作。

shots.scene: 直流接头在通电时被拔开，冒出电弧的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a DC connector pulled apart while current flows, with an arc between the contacts. No people.
shots.narration: 直流电断开时，容易拉出电弧。

shots.scene: 带电拔直流接头的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand unplugging a DC connector under load, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不在带负载时插拔接头。

shots.scene: 阿杰先关负载开关，再拔下接头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student switches off the load first, then unplugs the DC connector.
shots.narration: 先断开负载和电源，再插拔。

shots.scene: 王老师和小研在空白风险评估表前讨论
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the female graduate student discuss in front of a blank risk assessment form.
shots.narration: 做新实验前，先想一想风险。

shots.scene: 电池、光伏板、变阻器三个图标各配一个问号
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, a battery, a solar panel and a rheostat, each with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 哪里有电？哪里会烫？出事怎么办？

shots.scene: 空白表格上打勾，王老师签字
shots.prompt_en: Check marks appear on a blank form and the safety administrator signs it.
shots.narration: 措施落实，老师同意，再动手。

shots.scene: 天平平衡图标和 50% 饼图
shots.prompt_en: A balanced scale icon next to a half-filled pie chart. No people.
shots.narration: 负载等于内阻，功率最大，效率一半。

shots.scene: 最大功率和最高效率两个奖杯，中间不等号
shots.prompt_en: Two trophy icons, one for maximum power and one for maximum efficiency, with a not-equal sign between them. No people.
shots.narration: 记住：最大功率不等于最高效率。

shots.scene: 光伏板、功放、收音机三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a solar panel, an audio amplifier and a radio. No people.
shots.narration: 光伏跟踪、功放、收音机都用得上。

shots.scene: 电池护帽、回收箱、遮光布、断开的接头四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: battery terminal caps, a battery recycling bin, a cloth-covered solar panel, and an unplugged connector. No people.
shots.narration: 电池别短接，光伏见光有电。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整理好的实验台前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at a tidy lab bench with the battery pack capped.
shots.narration: 祝口试顺利，安全用电！
